dict.string: Open Linear issues with a live preview (li <issue-id or search>)
Type an issue ID (ENG-123) or search terms

## Setup
1. Create a personal API key at [linear.app/settings/account/security](https://linear.app/settings/account/security) 2. Open this workflow's Configuration in Alfred and paste the key.
## Usage
li ENG-123 exact issue lookup li billing bug full-text search (top 8)
An issue ID is matched exactly and falls back to search if it does not exist. Searches need at least two characters.
## Keys
- **Enter** - open in the browser - **Cmd+Enter** - open in the Linear desktop app - **Cmd+C** - copy the issue URL - **Shift** - Quick Look
